description:
Get the actual Python code behind a community leaderboard strategy.

    Takes an entry's `id` from `browse_community` or `find_strategy` and returns
    its real `feature_engineering()` + `strategy_config()` source, for the user
    to inspect or tweak. The same id passed to `one_shot` as `community_id`
    deploys it unchanged. Read-only, no signup needed.

    Args:
      community_id: The `id` of a community entry (from `browse_community`).

    Returns:
      dict with: id, title, username, description, symbol, timeframe,
      metrics {total_ret, win_rate, profit_factor, n_trades, mdd, sharpe_strat},
      and `code` (the full Python source).
name: get_strategy_code
title: Get Community Strategy Code
